brief.zh: 每一拍交出「接着数」在这一拍之前连着是 1 的拍数；它一是 0，就从 0 重数。
brief.en: Every tick, give out how many ticks in a row Go on was 1 before this one; once it is 0, start again from 0.

t.zh: 数拍只会一直往上数。要数"连着多少拍"，得在断的那一拍把数清零：板要能在两个值里挑一个。
t.en: Counting ticks only goes up. To count “how many in a row”, the count has to go back to zero on the tick the run breaks: the board has to pick one of two values.

t.zh: 新元件<part-ref to="part:select"></part-ref>：条件是「是」或 1 时给出「是」那一路，「否」或 0 时给出「否」那一路；没接的一路读作「—」。
t.en: A new part, <part-ref to="part:select"></part-ref>: when its condition is yes or 1 it gives its Yes input, when it is no or 0 its No input; an input left open reads 「—」.

desc.zh: 交出「接着数」在这一拍之前连着是 1 的拍数；「接着数」为 0 的那一拍过后从 0 重数。每一块计数器有自己的寄存卡。
desc.en: Gives how many ticks in a row Go on was 1 before this tick; after a tick where Go on is 0 it counts from 0 again. Each counter has registers of its own.

after.zh: 这块板现在是一个元件了，板上放几块，就各数各的。
after.en: This board is now a part, and several of them on one board each keep their own count.
